policy_until_t24_completes.rule: No member other than the verifier may create, modify, or delete anything under verification-t9/**, and no member may delete or clear anything under verification/** (deletion is captain-only).
policy_until_t24_completes.engine_output_redirection: A run whose evidenceDir/reportDir/traceFile resolves under verification/** is acceptable for release and CI (contract-mandated), but scratch/debug runs should be redirected (e.g. .qgate/out/**) so they do not churn the audit chain mid-verification.
policy_until_t24_completes.clean_runs: A clean end-to-end run targeting verification/** should be avoided while t24 is producing its report, so the verifier's fingerprint stays meaningful.
policy_until_t24_completes.if_you_need_a_clean_run: Use a separate scratch output directory and tell the captain.
